findings.claim: The `ServerAddress` enum was moved out of `ios/Litloft/Settings/ServerSettings.swift` into a new file `ios/Litloft/Share/ServerAddress.swift`, and that file is compiled into the extension target. Neither the move nor the new file is in the touch-point list.
findings.impact: Every caller of `ServerAddress.parse` now depends on a file shared with the extension, and a change to it affects the app's address validation and the extension's read of `share.server`. A reader of the touch-point list would not expect to look there.
findings.evidence: The diff deletes about 40 lines of `enum ServerAddress` from ServerSettings.swift. It adds Litloft/Share/ServerAddress.swift with the same body. pbxproj adds ServerAddress.swift (AA...56/57) to the LitloftShare Sources phase. The touch points name only SharedSession, the destination resolver, the folder validator and the filename port under `Share/`.

bucket_proposal.reason: Behaviour is unchanged (a verbatim move) and no declared invariant is broken. The spec list is incomplete.

findings.claim: The change reaches build-configuration surfaces that the touch points do not list: a new `LITLOFT_KEYCHAIN_GROUP` xcconfig variable, `keychain-access-groups` in both entitlements files, and custom Info.plist keys `LITLOFTAppGroup` and `LITLOFTKeychainGroup` in both the app and the extension. The listed `NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription` is not added to `Litloft-Info.plist`.
findings.impact: The keychain access group and the App Group lookup now depend on Info.plist values expanded at build time. A build without a team falls back silently to the bare group (`configured` returns nil), so the mirror and the extension could use different keychain scopes. The app has no local-network usage string, though the spec lists one.
findings.evidence: Shared.xcconfig adds LITLOFT_KEYCHAIN_GROUP. Litloft.entitlements and LitloftShare.entitlements add keychain-access-groups. The Litloft-Info.plist diff adds only LITLOFTAppGroup and LITLOFTKeychainGroup, and has no NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription. LitloftShare/Info.plist has it.

bucket_proposal.reason: Not covered by a declared invariant. I5's behaviour is not shown to break, and the missing app usage string is a spec/plist mismatch.

findings.claim: The frontend test `frontend/src/__tests__/inboxPage.test.tsx` was edited (a Shared label test and a ja.json key check) but is not in the touch-point list. Only `quickNoteFilename` tests and the fixture are listed for the frontend.
findings.impact: This is test-only, with no runtime effect. The touch-point list undercounts the files a reviewer must read.
findings.evidence: The diff adds `SPEC-CORE-033 labels a shared arrival Shared` and a ja key assertion, and imports `@/messages-core/ja.json` in inboxPage.test.tsx.

bucket_proposal.reason: The test supports I1 and the label, and breaks no invariant. Only the list is incomplete.

specification_compliance: SPEC-CORE-033 backend: the Literal, the I18N_KEYS lookup and the complete_upload change match I2, and the tests cover 422 values, both keys, the sidecar and the broadcast.
The frontend sourceShare keys and the fixture match the touch points.
Litloft-Info.plist lacks the listed NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription (see F2).
Outside the touch points: ServerAddress move (F1), the keychain-group build plumbing (F2), and the inboxPage test (F3).
potential_unspecified_behavior: `CookieStoreObserverRegistry` is a process-global singleton keyed by ObjectIdentifier; it is not in the spec.

`ShareSendQueue` treats a `.networkConnectionLost` on `/complete` as an unanswered request and polls, but treats `.notConnectedToInternet` as unreachable and stops. In the latter case the item is marked failed although the server may have received `/complete`.
regression_risks: Moving ServerAddress could change which target compiles it. The app picks it up through the synchronized Litloft group, while the extension lists it explicitly.

`forget()` now enumerates and deletes `share.` keys on every call, and its `GroupSharedSession()` default is built in `ServerSettings.init`. The existing ServerSettings tests may now touch the real group defaults and keychain.
test_coverage: Backend arrival tests cover the accepted and rejected values and the share key. The frontend label and the fixture are covered. I did not see the iOS tests, because the diff was truncated.
not_verified: The diff was cut at 200000 bytes, so I did not read the rest of ShareSheetView.swift, ShareViewController.swift, ShareStrings.swift or the iOS tests. Further unplanned files may exist there.
I did not check that the pbxproj compiles. I did not check the LitloftTests target membership (the diff shows odd PBXBuildFile entries) or the Xcode synchronized-group behaviour.
I did not run any tests or the app.
